description: CIIC maintains annual-report links for the investment corporation, airports, ports, electricity utilities and the water utility. The collection identifies reports for Te Aponga Uira, Te Mana Uira and To Tatou Vai alongside transport bodies. The provider is Cook Islands Investment Corporation and listed public utilities. Coverage: Coverage is the Cook Islands public infrastructure organisations. CIIC editions run from 2014 through 2024 on the page, with several utility reports for 2023 and 2024. Access: The official report index was read. Report files and their numerical tables were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Coverage differs by organisation and edition. The index establishes report availability, not a harmonised dataset or verified indicator definitions. For simulation it supplies source routes for institutional and annual utility-performance context. Related resources: The utilities policy is a separate institutional source, not a substitute for these annual organisational reports.
